name: journal-of-sports-research
description: Use when targeting 《体育学研究》(Journal of Sports Research, Nanjing Sport Institute) — a CSSCI journal focused on sport social science / sport humanities, valuing disciplined problem framing and substantive theoretical dialogue (sport sociology, governance, policy, history, philosophy). Best for theory-engaged sport social science with rigorous method; route exercise science and applied competitive work to the natural-science / 中国体育科技 venues, and reflective/methodological essays to 《体育与科学》.
